title: Idle claim holder alarm
current: The fleet watcher reads every live session's full roster row and emits a fleet ALARM idle-holder line for each work-claim holder silent past the idle threshold, parked or not. The line names the session, its items, idle minutes, mode, park reason, native process state (running, exited, resuming, or unknown from a roster that does not serve native_process_exited_at), surface and the item-addressed reach command. A healthy in-flight landing wait, a merged queue landing whose holder has not acted since the landing notice (merge_queue_notified_at), or an item standing at its pinned release wait does not alarm. An idle holder alarm names the nonterminal items whose blocked_by edges name its held items. A parked holder with dependents repeats hourly while they remain; a parked holder without dependents alarms once. An unparked holder repeats hourly while it stays idle. Either emits one fleet CLEAR idle-holder line when activity resumes. Steering answers every alarm in the same turn with an action or a one-line disposition saying why the wait is still sound. Both the report and watcher treat a live newest open long-running call as busy for at most 45 minutes; otherwise idle timing uses last_tool_call_at from real hook tool calls. The sessions.watcher_activity pulse refreshes only session and claim heartbeats. Pulses never count as tool work or suppress undelivered-message alarms; refusal to refresh liveness is named in the wrapper progress capture with recovery.
